data.why: The tool is a pure forward simulator driven entirely by sidebar-entered dissociation constants and concentration ranges; it has no file upload and no external data dependency.

goals: Simulate the normalized apparent diffusion time (tau_app/tau_m) vs. total protein concentration for a dimer-monomer equilibrium given a chosen Kd
Simulate the same curve for a trimer-monomer equilibrium given an effective Kd^E
Simulate the tetramer-dimer-monomer cascade given Kd1 (tetramer-dimer) and Kd2 (dimer-monomer)
Explore how labeling efficiency (f) and labeled protein concentration (C_L) shift the apparent diffusion time curve and species fractions
Set a concentration range matching a planned FCS titration experiment and inspect the resulting species fraction plot
Export the simulated tau_app and species-fraction curves as a CSV for use in manuscript figures or further analysis

review.summary: The tree describes this forward FCS oligomerization simulator well: its phases follow the README's set-up, simulate and export workflow, and all eight screens I opened support the claimed curves and numbers, including the two the checker flagged. It needs small fixes before filing: f2 wrongly says nothing recalculates until Run (switching models does), t5 and t7 omit the settings their numbers depend on, and t1's branch type and the full-screen task need tidying.
